name: Vivie Newfield
source:
"Vivie is my sister. For years she has been confined to a hospital bed, ill with a bone-wasting disease. She has been attending school classes from her laptop and honestly, she finds a way to smile and be happier than even me... She deserves better than this."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
